description: This file defines a locale/culture information object for the Uzbek language using Cyrillic script (uz-Cyrl-UZ) in the DateJS library. It includes cultural details such as day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing, and date manipulation functions tailored to this locale.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time components to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date equals another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns index of day based on name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns index of month based on name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns number of days in a specific month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns timezone name based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns timezone offset based on name.
